messages:
taylor_finance: Quick finance bulletin for FY26 planning 1: updates to per-diem, p-card delegations, and small-vendor approval thresholds. Please skim and flag questions. :spiral_calendar:

Highlights:
- Per-diem (effective 2026-04-01): Domestic = $125/day, International = $220/day. Mileage follows IRS rate in effect at travel date.
- Receipt threshold: receipts required for any single expense > $25. Phone photos accepted if legible.
- R&D / engineering buys: purchases under $3,000 follow Manager + Finance reviewer approval. $3,000 and up route to Procurement for review/PO.
- P-card delegations: default monthly = $2,000. Managers can request a temporary increase up to $5,000 for a max 30-day window (events, recruiting, vendor deposits).

Full policy: https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/c/expense-policies  Exceptions form: https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/c/expense-exception  :link:

sam_engineering: Are these changes retroactive? We booked an offsite for 2026-03-20 with hotel + flights.

taylor_finance: Not retroactive. Policy applies to spend on or after 2026-04-01. For bookings before that date, follow the prior rules. If you need an exception (e.g., vendor changed, higher fees), file the expense-exception form and tag @sophia_fd.

jamie_ops: When we request a p-card bump, what's the normal turnaround?

taylor_finance: Typical turnaround: ~2 business days for routine bumps. Up to 5 business days for larger/complex requests that need cross-org approvals. Use Procurement > Requests > P-Card Delegation Request and include justification + timeline.

procurement-bot: Update: vendor whitelist amended. Added "Nimbus Hardware, Inc." for incidental R&D purchases under $3,000. Whitelist: https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/c/vendor-whitelist

sophia_fd: Managers: please confirm budget-owner sign-off before approving exceptions. I'll follow up with teams that frequently request bumps. Also we'll sample uploads for receipt quality — low-quality images will be rejected. :eyes:

alex_sales: Thanks, forwarding to my team leads.

lena_admin: Quick Q: do we need full PDFs for receipts or are phone photos acceptable?

taylor_finance: Phone photos are acceptable if they clearly show vendor name, date, and amount. Upload via Concur mobile or the expense portal. Finance will ping you if anything looks off.

jamie_ops: Noted. One more: for event deposits (venue holds) that exceed $3k, do we need a PO before payment?

taylor_finance: Yes for >=$3,000 we generally require a PO. Work with Procurement early so they can issue a PO or advise on contract terms. For urgent cases, mark request as expedited and include event dates to speed review.

(End of thread)
